subject.title: [Bug]: iOS-compatible app on Apple Silicon Mac registers as a phantom iPad node

question: For an iOS App Store build running under Apple Silicon macOS compatibility mode, should Gateway metadata remain `platform: iOS` with an explicit Mac-hosted display/context marker, or should it be reclassified as macOS and receive macOS policy semantics?
rationale: The current Gateway derives default command access from platform metadata, so this identity correction also determines a trust-and-capability boundary.

options.title: Keep iOS policy; label compatibility host
options.body: Detect the compatibility runtime and expose a distinct display/context marker while retaining iOS platform and device-policy semantics.

options.title: Reclassify as macOS
options.body: Publish macOS platform/device-family metadata and explicitly accept the resulting macOS command-policy behavior after focused security review.

recommendation.title: Keep iOS policy; label compatibility host
recommendation.body: Detect the compatibility runtime and expose a distinct display/context marker while retaining iOS platform and device-policy semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source and repository guidance place this decision in the native iOS node area.
